label: Days Since El Mencho Killed
deltaNote: Day 196. EL 03 EXTRADITION ORDER CONFIRMED (Sep 4): Security Secretary García Harfuch confirmed a U.S. extradition order and dual Mexican-U.S. nationality for Juan Carlos Valencia González ('El 03'), El Mencho's stepson and U.S.-identified CJNG successor — born in Santa Ana, California; previously led the 'Elite Group' armed wing. OJOCALIENTE INVESTIGATION WIDENS (Sep 4): Harfuch disclosed ~200kg of explosives were used in the Aug 30 car bomb and confirmed two more detainees (Hipólito 'N,' Miguel 'N'), tied to an Aguascalientes-Zacatecas surveillance cell; a CJNG–Cártel del Pacífico turf dispute is now a lead investigative theory alongside the earlier retaliation motive. MANZANILLO ARREST (Sep 1): Colima SSPC/SEMAR detained two suspected CJNG/Los Mezcales members, seizing a 40mm grenade launcher. CHALCO ARREST (Sep 3): Mexico State forces detained two suspects with a large drug cache in Chalco, Edomex, on an unconfirmed suspected CJNG-cell link. Day 192. OJOCALIENTE CAR BOMB TOLL REVISED, FIRST ARREST, MILITARY DEPLOYED (Aug 30–Sep 2): Updated official figures put the Aug 30 Ojocaliente, Zacatecas car bomb (attributed to CJNG) at 11 wounded and ~40 homes affected. Zacatecas authorities detained the first suspect, Juan Pedro 'N,' in Cuauhtémoc municipality Sep 1, carrying a homemade explosive, a grenade, and spike strips. SEDENA activated Plan DN-III-E and deployed a 'Genaro Codina' military task force to Ojocaliente Sep 2. The bombing was the third of a three-attack wave (El Chique dam ambush Aug 27, Villa García motorcycle bomb Aug 29) and CJNG's first documented vehicle-borne device of the post-Mencho campaign. R-2 NAMED LOS RS SUCCESSOR, CHARGED (Aug 27): A Washington, D.C. federal grand jury indicted 'El R-1' (arrested Jul 30) and his brother Rafael Álvarez Ayala ('El R-2'), identified by Mexican authorities as R-1's successor atop the CJNG-affiliated 'Los Rs' cell in Michoacán; R-2 remains at large. CJNG DRONE UNIT SPANS 5 STATES (Aug 26): InSight Crime detailed CJNG's 'Operadores Droneros' unit adapting commercial drones for IED drops, chemical payloads, and a helicopter attack across Michoacán, Guanajuato, Chihuahua, Jalisco, and Baja California. 20 MORE CJNG DETAINED, EXOTIC ANIMALS SEIZED (Aug 24): García Harfuch announced 20 alleged CJNG members detained in Aug 21-23 raids across 36 properties in Hidalgo, Jalisco, and Michoacán; combined with the Aug 19 Tío Lako-cell raid, 32 total CJNG members detained in under a week. SUCCESSION BINARY HOLDS: El 03 (confirmed leader, $25M) vs. El Sapo (military wing/Puerto Vallarta plaza boss, $15M) — both remain at large.
